purpose: Track who controls the room, the body, the language, the next step, and the record in each setting.

setting_rules.authority_pattern: family_and_care_team_share_room; law/professionals govern verification and release
clinical team controls equipment/procedure; family/surrogate participates through communication and decisions within law/policy
setting_rules.common_misread: machines mean the person is not dying

setting_rules.authority_pattern: emergency team controls resuscitation/triage; family access may be abrupt or limited
resident belongings and family meaning coexist with facility staffing, policy, and hospice overlay
setting_rules.common_misread: facility death has no home quality

setting_rules.authority_pattern: state controls access, body, official record, and notification pathways
setting_rules.common_misread: official record is complete lived truth

setting_rules.authority_pattern: publicness, police/EMS/medical examiner, peers, outreach workers, and property rules shape dignity
humanitarian/forensic/public-health systems govern identification and body management under pressure
setting_rules.common_misread: dead bodies are generic hazards rather than persons

setting_rules.authority_pattern: funeral/forensic/disposition workers control technical handling while family meaning and law remain active
setting_rules.common_misread: after body leaves, the story is over

public_surface_rule: Render the authority pattern before any description that might sound like a recommendation.
